units.source_text: 男人迎着“黑荆棘”抄起铁锹，用力地左右挥舞起来。

en.t: The man faced the “black thorns,” grabbed up the shovel, and began swinging it forcefully from side to side.

units.source_text: 他调整着角度，希望铁锹快口上的亮光，能轻松地反射进对方的眼睛……

en.t: He adjusted the angle, hoping the glint from the sharp edge of the shovel would easily flash into his opponent’s eyes...

units.source_text: 眼睛的深处铺开烤过的水银之膜……

en.t: Deep inside the eyes spread a film of scorched mercury...

units.source_text: 那女人磨磨蹭蹭还在干什么，还不快点出来帮帮忙……

en.t: What was that woman still dawdling over? Why didn’t she hurry out and help him...
